summary: At the owner's request, the six records that reviewers had flagged as judgment calls were sent to a second independent AI review that had not seen the research: c06-11 (China House), c06-10 (inauguration aid, payments and hiring freeze), c03-07 (political appointee ranks), c07-12 (FARA authorities), c07-13 (NCSC authorities and FBI counterintelligence resources) and c07-10 (intelligence support for BIS and CFIUS). Every stage held on re-derivation and none was judged evenly balanced. Evidence was added to each record: State's Foreign Affairs Manual and H.R. 5329 on the China office; an AP-reported State cable and political-appointee review, with the court status moved from enjoined to pending, on the freeze; OPM's 2025-02-24 memorandum asking agencies to redesignate career-reserved SES positions, which corrected a sentence in c03-07; the NSPM-7 FARA directive and a Federal Register check showing no final FARA rule; S. 4615 section 601(e), flat FY2026 FBI funding and the NCSC Director confirmation; and Division F sections 6612 and 6614 of Public Law 119-60 plus the FY2027 BIS request. Confidence moved on all six (56, 74, 74, 66, 60, 64).
title: Second independent review of six judgment-call records
